name: todo-app
description: Minimal full-stack todo app: React + Vite, Express, PostgreSQL

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run install:all && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('server/.env.example','server/.env',require('fs').constants.COPYFILE_EXCL)" || echo server/.env already exists
scripts.dev: npm run db:up && concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:client"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
